tagline.en_US: LM Studio can run local AI models like gpt-oss, Llama, Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek privately on your computer.

description.en_US: LM Studio is an application that runs local AI models privately on your computer. It supports running language models such as gpt-oss, Llama, Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek entirely offline without relying on external cloud services. Through its developer ecosystem and SDK, it also provides programmatic access to local models and workflows.

tips: LM Studio and LLMster cannot run at the same time because both manage overlapping runtime resources.
